instruction_summary: Section 6A concept-art coverage audit for ep01 against the finalised shot_list; produce directing/ep01/concept_coverage.json as the G6 precondition for H3A and p7-* dispatch.
key_rulings: CRE-001 and CHAR-white-rabbit kept strictly separate, each with its own sheet; neither reported as the other's gap.

ep01 requires ZERO costume sheets: all three costumes in the episode (COS-001 / COS-003 / COS-006) are their character's default outfit and are carried by that character's sheet.png per the costume_sheets.json ledgers. Section 6A only requires sheet_<COS-id>.png for a non-default costume. The costume-sheet deferral therefore never bites in ep01.
CRE-001 requires no stage variant: creature.json forms[] holds a single form ('waking-real', since ch001) and mount.json registers zero mounts project-wide.
Scene required views = layout_top.png + layout.json only; grid_9views.png is retired and not counted. No ep01 scene carries a legacy single-angle main_*.png.

Prop images turned out to be fully in stock on this project (main_01 + scale_ref_01 for all seven), so the prop-image deferral is moot for ep01; it is still recorded as an explicit exclusion rather than a gap.

None of the 7 H2-waived majors in runs/g4/gate.json was re-raised. Image-quality waivers are not coverage gaps; the three that touch ep01 entities are carried forward as prompt text-layer instructions instead.

verification.path_existence: All 39 claimed in-stock paths stat-ed on disk (no inference from naming convention); a post-write re-walk of concept_coverage.json re-checked every row's `exists` flag against the filesystem — 0 mismatches.
verification.image_dimensions: Read from file headers. All 3 character sheets, the creature sheet and all 7 scene layout_top plates are 2560x1440 (= the 3,686,400 px MIN_PIXELS floor). Prop images are 1280x720 / 1024x1024.

host_cli.warn_explanation: The 7 WARNs are all '无法读取 layout_top.png (No module named PIL)' — Pillow is not importable from this shell, so the script could not read pixel size itself. Verified independently from the JPEG SOF headers; all seven plates meet the floor exactly.

verification.cross_check: directing/ep01/storyboard.json yields an identical entity ID set to shot_list.json (3 CHAR, 1 CRE, 7 SCN, 7 PROP, 3 COS) — no storyboard-only entity was dropped in the shot-planning pass.

prop concept images — deferred by user instruction (moot here: all present)

No new S/A lead appeared in ep01 that Phase 4 had missed, so no H3A preview-page 'new concept art, confirm as an H2 extension' callout is needed.

concept_coverage.json was written directly in one pass; no generator script. The only code run was the host CLI blocking_map_check.py plus inline verification one-liners.
